# OtaHub Asia (English Edition)

> OtaHub Asia is a premier bilingual digital publication providing breaking news, in-depth reviews, gameplay guides, and cultural analysis on Asian Anime, Gaming, Manga, Light Novels, and Otaku Culture.

## Core Hubs & Content Categories

- [Anime Hub](https://otahub.asia/en/anime): Latest anime announcements, seasonal broadcast schedules, trailer breakdowns, and studio spotlights (MAPPA, Ufotable, Wit Studio, Kyoto Animation, CloverWorks, A-1 Pictures).
- [Gaming Hub](https://otahub.asia/en/gaming): PC, Console (PS5, Switch, Xbox), and Mobile gaming news, Souls-like coverage, JRPGs, Gacha guides, and major updates.
- [Manga Hub](https://otahub.asia/en/manga): Shonen Jump, Kodansha, and Kadokawa release dates, weekly plot summaries, and author profiles.
- [Reviews](https://otahub.asia/en/reviews): Unbiased, score-based reviews of AAA blockbusters, indie gems, and theatrical anime features.
- [Rankings](https://otahub.asia/en/rankings): Community character polls, seasonal top lists, meta tier lists, and box-office tracking.
- [Tag Explorer](https://otahub.asia/tag): Dynamic tag search for studios, genres, franchises, and voice actors.

## Bilingual Editions

- [Vietnamese Edition (Main)](https://otahub.asia/): Comprehensive coverage with 300+ full-length guides and analysis.
- [English Edition](https://otahub.asia/en/): Curated international news and English localization.

## Major Covered Franchises

- Anime/Manga: One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man, Demon Slayer, Attack on Titan, Solo Leveling, Bleach, Frieren, Black Clover, Dandadan, Blue Lock, The Apothecary Diaries.
- Gaming: Black Myth: Wukong, Elden Ring, Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium, Ghost of Yōtei, Death Stranding 2, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, Monster Hunter Wilds, Switch 2, League of Legends (LCK / Worlds 2026), VALORANT.

## Syndication & Machine-Readable Feeds

- [Sitemap XML](https://otahub.asia/sitemap.xml): Full URL hierarchy for all pages and localized editions.
- [RSS Feed](https://otahub.asia/feed.xml): Real-time XML syndication feed.
- [JSON Feed](https://otahub.asia/feed.json): Standard JSON feed endpoint for automated aggregators.
